title: Justine
author: Marquis de Sade
current_text: In 1791, authorities in France suppressed Justine or the Misfortunes of Virtue. In March 1801 the stocks of The New Justine and Juliette were seized when Sade was arrested at his publisher's office. The Cour Royale de Paris ordered the book's destruction on 19 May 1815.

sources.quote:
1791, France: The authorities doggedly suppressed "Justine or the
Misfortunes of Virtue" and Juliette."
